title: Realizations of exponential sheaves and Fourier transform
summary: This note concerns exponential sheaves, their realizations, and Fourier transforms, in the setting of mixed Hodge modules and D-modules. For relative categories of exponential sheaves constructed out of regular/tame objects, we study realization functors to holonomic (not necessarily regular) D-modules and show that they are t-exact, faithful on the heart, and compatible with the usual functors (including Verdier duality).
